title: The Legend of Zelda - A Link to the Past & Four Swords

match.zip: Legend of Zelda, The - A Link to the Past & Four Swords.zip

sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 580 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
SNES save layout knowledge (GBA keeps it 0x20 lower)
notes: Genre: Action adventure. World flag bit 0x40 = Dark World is from the SNES game; crystal bit order from the SNES layout (RA note confirms bits 0-1). C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: B sword (hold for Spin Attack), A action/lift/dash with boots, R use item, L/Select map (A Link to the Past).
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: multiplayer-only (needs link cable); Riddle Quest unlocks after it.
widgets.label: Four Swords

widgets.text: Swords: Fighter -> Master -> Tempered -> Golden. Shields: Fighter -> Fire -> Mirror. Tunics: Green -> Blue -> Red mail. Gloves: Power -> Titan's Mitt.
widgets.label: Upgrades

widgets.text: Armos Knights (bow), Lanmolas, Moldorm (keep it off the edges), Agahnim (reflect his spells with the sword), Helmasaur King (hammer the mask), Arrghus (Hookshot the puffs), Mothula, Blind (light), Kholdstare (fire), Vitreous, Trinexx (Ice/Fire Rods), Ganon (silver arrows).
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Eastern Palace, Desert Palace, Tower of Hera -> Agahnim at Hyrule Castle.
widgets.label: Light World

widgets.text: Palace of Darkness, Swamp Palace, Skull Woods, Thieves' Town, Ice Palace, Misery Mire, Turtle Rock, Ganon's Tower.
widgets.label: Dark World

widgets.text: Bow, Boomerang, Hookshot, Bombs, Mushroom/Magic Powder, Fire Rod, Ice Rod, Bombos, Ether, Quake, Lamp, Hammer, Flute, Bug Net, Book of Mudora, Bottles, Cane of Somaria, Cane of Byrna, Magic Cape, Magic Mirror, Pegasus Boots, Flippers, Moon Pearl.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: 24 Pieces of Heart (4 = 1 container). Bottles: 4. Golden bees and fairies fill bottles.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: 3 Pendants of Virtue (Master Sword), then rescue the 7 maidens from the Dark World crystals and defeat Ganon.
widgets.label: Goal
